summary: Verified Platform Super Admin password-reset flow end-to-end. Backend pytest = 208/208 PASS (with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported). Found & FIXED a frontend syntax error in PlatformSchoolDetailPage.js (ImpersonateButton component was missing its closing </Dialog></); ); } — the whole app failed to compile, so the Users tab/reset flow was unreachable until this was fixed). After fix, all five UI flows pass: (1) umv-hajipur owner archana.jaiswal2709@gmail.com / TempPass@12345 logs in → lands on /school. (2) superadmin@schoolos.dev / SuperAdmin@123 lands on /platform. (3) Platform → Schools → search 'umv' → click row → Users tab (detail-tab-users) is visible, tenant-users-table lists Archana with a Reset password button. (4) Fresh school registered, superadmin opened its Users tab, clicked Reset, left new password blank, typed a 36-char reason, clicked Reset → reset-password-result + reset-password-value (OrDMOeSqDhv2kQA1!) displayed with working Copy button; logging out as superadmin and logging in as the new school owner with that temp password succeeded → /school. (5) GET /api/v1/platform/audit-logs confirms action='user.password_reset' entries are being written (5 entries for the test tenants).

minor.issue: The ?action= query parameter is ignored — passing ?action=user.password_reset still returns all audit entries. Client has to filter in-memory. Not blocking (list endpoint still contains the entries).

Audit entry response exposes only 'metadata': {} — the reason & 'generated' flag passed to log_event via new_value={'reason': ...} are not surfaced in the API response. The underlying backend test asserts on the DB record directly, but API consumers (UI) cannot see the reason.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Honour the ?action= query param in GET /api/v1/platform/audit-logs so clients can filter by action name.
(Optional / minor) Return the reason (new_value.reason) in the audit-logs list response, or copy reason into metadata, so Platform Console can display why a password was reset.
critical_code_review_comments: PlatformSchoolDetailPage.js had an unbalanced JSX: ImpersonateButton returned <Dialog>…<DialogContent>…</DialogContent> with no closing </Dialog>, ); or } — the file compiled only because of a stray </Dialog>);} appended at the very bottom. This caused the entire frontend bundle to fail with a Babel SyntaxError at line 245 ('Unexpected token const [users, setUsers] = useState([])') the moment TenantUsersTab was added. FIXED by closing ImpersonateButton properly (added </Dialog> );} after DialogFooter, and removed the dangling closers at EOF).

The Reset password endpoint stores the admin's reason in audit new_value but it's not returned in the audit-logs API response — Platform Console audit screen will show action name only, not the justification.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: umv login, superadmin login, Users tab visible with reset button, full E2E reset+new-pw login, audit entry present)

test_credentials: Platform: superadmin@schoolos.dev / SuperAdmin@123. umv-hajipur owner: archana.jaiswal2709@gmail.com / TempPass@12345. Fresh school owners registered dynamically via /api/v1/auth/register-school with password SchoolOwner@123.
seed_data_creation: A few throwaway test schools were registered via /api/v1/auth/register-school during E2E (slugs like testowxnfl). They are harmless but can be cleaned up if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Platform-side password reset is now fully working end-to-end. The frontend compile error has been fixed. All critical data-testids (detail-tab-users, tenant-users-table, tenant-user-reset-{id}, reset-password-dialog, reset-password-reason, reset-password-confirm, reset-password-result, reset-password-value, reset-password-copy, reset-password-close) are wired correctly. Note that the platform Schools list is paginated — to find a specific tenant like 'umv-hajipur' among 445 tenants, you must type into [data-testid=schools-search]. Navigation to tenant detail is triggered by clicking on the school NAME cell (not the slug text).
rca of the issue: Root cause of initial 'all UI tests fail' was a JSX syntax error inside PlatformSchoolDetailPage.js: the newly-added TenantUsersTab was inserted BEFORE the previous ImpersonateButton component had been closed (missing </Dialog></); }). Babel parse-fail → whole SPA bundle failed to compile → login page itself did not render → every selector lookup timed out. Reproduced by loading /login and seeing the 'Compiled with problems: Unexpected token (245:2)' CRA error overlay. Mitigation: closed ImpersonateButton correctly and removed the stray closers at the end of file; hot-reload picked up the fix and all 5 E2E flows then passed.
